content.text:
All 18 rules were searched and a plan submitted for each. Key planning notes for the reviewing team:

- **Located and substantive:** LOL-CAP (§15.3 mutual consequential waiver — cap presence to be verified), INDEMN (§15.1/15.2 plus Attachment 6 indemnities), NOSOLICIT (§9.0 p0189 binds IBM), RENEWAL (§4.0 p0104 auto-renewal), GOVLAW (§16.9 New York, court venue), ASSIGN (§16.2 consent bar; §16.5 sale/merger), IP (§13.0–13.3 ownership assigns to IBM), WARRANTY (SOW §19 suite), AUDIT (rights largely run against MSL), LD (PO cancellation charges, termination pricing), MINCOMMIT (forecast/inventory buyback exposure rather than take-or-pay), TRANSITION (§5.2 rights upon termination).
- **Direction-favourable, not to be flagged:** MFN (p1099 most-favored-customer pricing to IBM).
- **Likely absent (presence rules):** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY — no restriction on IBM located; workers should confirm across Product Attachments.
- **Gap risks flagged for analysis:** T4C (no convenience right for IBM in §5.1 — requires full pagination) and INSURANCE (only consigned-inventory and tooling insurance; no programme-level insurance article).
